class.name: IfcTimePeriod
class.brief_description: IfcTimePeriod defines a time period given by a start and end time. Both time definitions consider the time zone and allow for the daylight savings offset. HISTORY: New entity in IFC R2x4. Use definitions A time period is defined by a start and an end time, which is defined by IfcTime . The given time period should be within reasonable values (for example, the start time must be before the end time
